radar.instrument: Texture statistics of the slope grid (terrain-roughness proxy, not radar)

mineral.instrument: Sentinel-2 L2A S2A_17RNJ_20230724_0_L2A, cloud-masked land pixels (89% of the window clear, 0% open water)

thermal.instrument: MODIS Terra monthly land surface temperature 2023, NASA Worldview (GIBS): warmest-month day, coldest-month night

curve.instrument: Sine-based day-night model between the low and high
